title: When Will Ayumu Make His Move?
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: First-year Ayumu Tanaka joins his school's tiny shogi club because he is in love with his senpai, Urushi Yaotome, and has vowed to confess only after he beats her at shogi. As a beginner he keeps losing, while Urushi, who suspects his crush, keeps trying to make him admit it. Friends and new club members add side romances.
life_message: It holds up keeping your word and earning the right moment through patient effort.

content.note: Comic scares at a haunted house and horror film (Wikipedia).
Flirtatious teasing, hugs and near-kisses; an adult-film misunderstanding gag (Wikipedia; MangaDex safe).

dominant: Slow-burn courtship; keeping a vow; discipline through a traditional game
